class.name: OpenDustIdentity
class.brief_description: Consumer of pods.global identity. Local session only in this phase.
class.description: OpenDust never runs its own login or stores passwords; it consumes the pods.global single sign-on. The OIDC flow is not implemented yet ([method sign_in] returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]); every device runs with the local session [code]{family_id:"local", user_id:"local", display_name:<os user>, scopes:["local"]}[/code]. See [code]docs/opendust/05-identity.md[/code].

method.name: get_session
method.description: The active session; the local session while signed out.
